answer: Trust terraces: every new identity starts on the lowest terrace, where rewards are capped at a hollow trickle and each claim needs a peer attestation. Climbing a terrace requires three epochs of verified useful work, and the climb is per identity, not per operator. A sybil army of a hundred fresh keys earns a hundred trickles, never a comet's tail of pooled rewards. Splitting work across aliases therefore costs the operator the same total effort for far less payout, while one honest identity climbs and earns more.
